message.content:
You are building the "Build with Claude AI" feature for the Nxeon VPS platform at /opt/nxeon — customers submit a plain-English prompt and Claude configures their server. THREE other agents are editing OTHER areas of this repo concurrently; ONLY touch YOUR OWNED FILES.

## CODEBASE PRIMER
- Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Prisma. Server Actions in `lib/actions-*.ts` marked `"use server"` export ONLY async functions (constants/types go in plain modules).
- Prisma: `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`. NEW models already generated:
  - `ClaudeBuild { id, userId, user, serverId, server, prompt, status(String: QUEUED|RUNNING|DONE|FAILED), log(String), steps(Int), createdAt, updatedAt }`.
  - NEW `JobType.CLAUDE_BUILD` exists in the enum.
- Auth: `import { requireUser, currentUser } from "@/lib/auth"`. ALWAYS verify the target server belongs to the current user (`db.server.findFirst({ where: { id, userId: user.id } })`).
- A `Server` has `ipAddress` (private 10.20.0.x), `sshPort`, `rootPassword`, `status`, `hostname`. The WORKER process runs on the Proxmox host and can reach VMs on the private bridge `vmbr1` (10.20.0.0/24) directly.
- The worker: `worker/index.ts` has a `handlers: Record<string,(job:Job)=>Promise<void>>` map and a `loadServer(job)` helper. Jobs are created by writing a `db.job.create({ data:{ type, serverId, payload } })` row. **You do NOT edit worker/index.ts** — you write the handler in `worker/claude.ts` exporting `export async function claudeBuild(job: Job): Promise<void>`; the orchestrator wires it into the handlers map.
- Design system (globals.css): `.card`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-danger`, `.input`, `.table-shell`. Dark premium theme, slate text, brand accent. Primitives: `import { PageHeader, Badge, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`.
- READ FIRST: `worker/index.ts` (see `loadServer`, `notify`, and how a handler is shaped — the `backupCreate`/`passwordReset` handlers), `lib/actions-server.ts` (server-action + ownership style), and `components/customer/Console.tsx` (a polling client component pattern).
- NO new npm dependencies. Call the Anthropic API with `fetch` (endpoint `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`, header `x-api-key: ${process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}`, `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`, model `claude-sonnet-5`). For SSH exec from the worker use `child_process.execFile` with `sshpass` (`sshpass -p <rootPassword> ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@<ipAddress> <command>`); wrap each exec with a timeout.

## WHAT TO BUILD (safe MVP)
A prompt → agentic build loop, **gated by `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`** (if unset, the feature shows a "not enabled yet — ask an admin to add an API key" state and does not run). Flow:
1. Customer picks one of their RUNNING servers and enters a prompt (e.g. "install and configure a Node.js app with nginx and a firewall").
2. `submitBuild` creates a `ClaudeBuild` (status QUEUED) + a `CLAUDE_BUILD` job.
3. `worker/claude.ts` `claudeBuild(job)`: loop up to a **hard cap of 12 steps** — call Claude asking for the NEXT single shell command (or "DONE") given the goal + prior command outputs; execute it via SSH on the server (per-command timeout ~120s); append `$ command` + output to `ClaudeBuild.log`; increment `steps`; stop on "DONE", the cap, or an error. Set final status DONE/FAILED. Keep the system prompt tight and safety-minded (operate only on this server, no destructive whole-disk ops).
4. Customer watches the streaming log (poll every ~2s) and sees status + steps.

## YOUR OWNED FILES (create ONLY these)
- `lib/anthropic.ts` — `anthropicConfigured()` + `askClaude(messages, system)` fetch wrapper returning the text.
- `lib/actions-claude.ts` (`"use server"`) — `submitBuild(serverId, prompt)` (ownership + RUNNING check + rate sanity), returns the build id; `listBuilds(serverId?)`.
- `worker/claude.ts` — `export async function claudeBuild(job: Job): Promise<void>` (the loop above). Also export a plain `CLAUDE_MAX_STEPS` const if useful.
- `app/dashboard/build/page.tsx` — `requireUser()`; server picker + prompt form + recent builds list; shows the not-enabled state when `!anthropicConfigured()`.
- `components/customer/ClaudeBuilder.tsx` (`"use client"`) — the form + a live-polling log viewer.
- `app/api/claude/[id]/route.ts` — ownership-checked GET returning `{ status, steps, log }` for polling.

## HARD RULES
- NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config.ts, app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, components/portal/Shell.tsx, app/dashboard/layout.tsx, app/admin/layout.tsx, lib/auth.ts, lib/db.ts, lib/rbac.ts, **worker/index.ts**, worker/billing.ts, lib/actions.ts, ROADMAP.md, docs/**, app/sitemap.ts, or any file not in your owned list.
- Do NOT run `npm run build`, `next build`, `prisma db push/migrate/generate`, or restart services. Do NOT git commit/push. No new npm deps. Verify your own types by reasoning (a project-wide `npx tsc --noEmit` is slow/shared — avoid).
- `"use server"` files export ONLY async functions.
- Enforce ownership on every server access. Cap steps + timeouts. Never run if `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is unset.

## FINAL REPORT
Files created; how the loop + gating + SSH exec work; INTEGRATION NEEDED (exact handlers-map line for worker/index.ts: `CLAUDE_BUILD: claudeBuild` + import; customer nav link to `/dashboard/build`; the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` env var); risks/limits.

## Summary

Built the "Build with Claude AI" feature end-to-end across the 6 owned files. No forbidden files touched, no deps added, no builds/migrations run.

### Files created
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/anthropic.ts` — `anthropicConfigured()` (sync gate on `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) + `askClaude(messages, system, opts)` fetch wrapper (endpoint `/v1/messages`, `x-api-key`, `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`, model `claude-sonnet-5`), with an AbortController timeout, returns concatenated text.
- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-claude.ts` (`"use server"`, only async exports) — `submitBuild(serverId, prompt)` and `listBuilds(serverId?)`.
- `/opt/nxeon/worker/claude.ts` — `export async function claudeBuild(job)` + `export const CLAUDE_MAX_STEPS = 12`.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/build/page.tsx` — server-component page (picker + form + recent-builds table + not-enabled state).
- `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/ClaudeBuilder.tsx` (`"use client"`) — form + 2s-polling live log viewer.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/api/claude/[id]/route.ts` — ownership-checked GET returning `{ status, steps, log }`.

### How it works
- **Gating:** `anthropicConfigured()` is checked in three places — the page (shows the "not enabled — ask an admin" card), `submitBuild` (rejects), and `claudeBuild` (marks the build FAILED without running). If the key is unset, nothing executes.
- **Submit flow:** `submitBuild` calls `requireUser()`, enforces ownership via `db.server.findFirst({ where: { id, userId: user.id } })`, requires `status === "RUNNING"` and a reachable IP/password, applies rate sanity (≤3 active builds/user, ≤5/min, one in-flight per server), creates a `ClaudeBuild` (QUEUED) + a `CLAUDE_BUILD` job with `payload: { buildId }`, and returns the build id.
- **Worker loop:** reads the build via `payload.buildId`, sets RUNNING, then loops up to `CLAUDE_MAX_STEPS` (12): asks Claude for the next single shell command (or `DONE`) given goal + prior outputs; runs it over SSH; appends `$ command` + output to `ClaudeBuild.log`; increments `steps`. Stops on `DONE`, the cap, a Claude/API error, or unsafe command. Sets final status DONE/FAILED and fires a notification. The system prompt is tight and safety-minded (single server only, non-interactive, no destructive whole-disk ops), plus a regex backstop (`isForbidden`) that refuses `rm -rf /`, `mkfs`, `dd of=/dev/*`, reboot/shutdown, fork bombs, etc. and asks Claude to adapt.
- **SSH exec:** `execFile("sshpass", ["-p", rootPassword, "ssh", -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no/UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null/ConnectTimeout=10, "root@<ipAddress>", "bash -c '<cmd>'"])` — connects to the private `10.20.0.x` IP on port 22 (worker is on `vmbr1`), 120s per-command timeout, output truncated (4KB/cmd, 60KB total log).
- **Polling:** client component posts the server action, then polls `/api/claude/[id]` every 2s until status is DONE/FAILED, auto-scrolling the streamed log.

### Risks / limits
- Claude executes real root shell commands on the customer's VM. Mitigations: 12-step cap, 120s per-command timeout, non-destructive system prompt + regex backstop, RUNNING-only + ownership + rate limits. It is not a hard sandbox — a determined prompt could still run risky-but-not-blocklisted commands, so the UI states the customer owns the outcome.
- Worker jobs are globally serialized (single poll loop), so no concurrent SSH sessions; but a `CLAUDE_BUILD` job that *throws* (only the malformed "missing/!found build" cases) would be retried by `runJob` and eventually flip the server to ERROR — normal build failures are caught internally and never throw, so this only fires on genuinely broken jobs.
- Log is capped at 60KB; long installs get truncated output fed back to Claude, which can reduce its context on very large builds.
- Model id `claude-sonnet-5` is used verbatim per the task spec; if that id isn't valid for the account, `askClaude` will surface the API error into the build log and mark it FAILED.
